name: Requests
description: Allows users to submit media requests.
overview: A Jellyfin plugin for requesting movies and TV shows.

versions.changelog: Merges duplicate search results that share a provider ID; editable request statuses (name and colour) in General settings, with "Available" removed; notes shown in My Requests; search button aligned with the search box; header button icon fixed in the React header.

Fixes quality options gaining the defaults back after a restart; fixes the header icon on first load; adds a Requests entry to the dashboard sidebar; shows "Already requested" for titles other users requested; compact My Requests cards; request errors always visible; removes unused API endpoints and code.

Requests page now hides the Media Bar slideshow and backdrops (pausing trailers) and uses the theme's background; admin status dropdown shows each status in its own colour with "In Progress" spelled out; clearer per-status card icons; header button hidden on dashboard pages.

Shows the Requests header button in Jellyfin's React header layout (also used with Jellyfin Enhanced), styled like the neighbouring SyncPlay button, and positions the Requests page under whichever header is visible.

Adds a reliable Requests header button next to SyncPlay for all signed-in users, rebuilds the Requests page with native Jellyfin styling so themes and custom CSS apply, adds a request dialog with season/episode selection, and resolves library status server-side for faster searches.

Rewrites the administrator settings page as a proper Jellyfin page controller (fixes the browser freeze, tabs, and settings), fixes the header Requests button, supports server base URLs, and fixes several request and library-status bugs.
Restores reliable Requests navigation and administrator settings initialization, including tabs, provider health, media options, and quality options.
Fixes Requests header navigation and ensures the existing public Requests page opens for authenticated users.
Fixes administrator settings script loading so the General and Requests tabs, provider status, and media quality controls initialize reliably.
Improves administrator settings initialization and isolates general-tab loading failures so tabs, provider status, and media quality options remain usable.
Makes the existing Requests page publicly accessible to authenticated users through a dedicated header route while keeping administrator settings separate.
Fixes administrator settings tabs and loading by serving the configuration logic as an external embedded script.
Fixes administrator tab navigation, removes Diagnostics, adds editable media quality options and media-type toggles, and persists settings to the public Requests controls.
Uses Jellyfin ApiClient authentication for Requests API calls, restores In Library detection, and changes the header icon to how_to_vote.
Adds the Requests header button using Jellyfin's native startup-filter and header-button pattern, placing it beside the Enhanced random button.
Adds a visible Requests icon and navigation link for authenticated users while preserving the existing public Requests page and administrator settings page.
Fixes plugin settings page selection and aligns Requests navigation injection with the Jellyfin Custom Tabs File Transformation integration.
Adds administrator General, Requests, and Diagnostics tabs with request filtering, sorting, details, status actions, deletion, status history, and storage diagnostics.
Adds provider-ID-only library availability and duplicate detection, moves Requests into Jellyfin home navigation, and restricts administration to plugin settings.
Fixes My Requests ownership and cancellation, preserves requested-media state after refresh, adds library availability detection, and restores plugin configuration page navigation.

Fixes requested-media state refresh, adds configurable movie and TV media quality selections, adds administrator request management columns for notes and quality, and adds General Settings quality-option controls.

Fixes movie requests by separating the movie dialog from the TV modal; enlarges the search box, reduces the media dropdown size, adds a visible My Requests list, and repairs the manifest JSON for reliable installation.

Adds Request Management v2: administration search and filtering, sortable request records, expanded status controls, details dialogs, movie notes, TV season and episode requests, duplicate protection, persistence migration, and native Jellyfin metadata identification.

Fixes metadata result casing so titles, overviews, posters, years, and provider data display correctly; fixes Request submissions that previously received an empty title; adds cache-busting for the user page.

Adds an installed plugin manifest for reliable Jellyfin upgrade reconciliation and exposes the Media Requests search page from plugin navigation, while replacing direct TMDb search with native Jellyfin metadata identification.
Replaces direct external search integration with Jellyfin native metadata identification for movie and TV search, with provider metadata request persistence and updated configuration tabs.
Fixes Jellyfin API authentication challenges and updates the package checksum and version metadata.
Fixes Jellyfin API authentication challenges and request package metadata.
